paite: Luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un noute hon sinsak dia thu ahon piak, thupiak, dan thuseh leh dan hiaite ahi uh.
heading: Thupiak Thupi

paite: Huai bel nou leh na tapate uh leh na tupate un TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ua, na damsung teng ua adan leh athupiak ka hon piak tengteng na zuihna ding uh leh na hong ten sawttheihna ding uh ahi.

Huaiziak in Israel mite aw, lamzang a TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon kamchiam bang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a nakpitak a na hong puntheihna ding un, ngaikhia unla, zui ding in pilvang un.
Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, TOUPA na Pathian uh kia TOUPA ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng un, na lungsim tengteng un, na hatna tengteng un na it ding uh ahi.
Hiai thu, tuni a ka hon piak na lungtang uah ataam gige ding a;
na tate uh phatuamngaitak in na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un leh na thoh chiang bang un na gen ding uh ahi.
Chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in a-om ding ahi.
Na inn kongkhak biang leh na kongkhak uah na gelh ding uhi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a ahon piak gam, na bawlkhiak uh hi het lou,
heading: Thuman Louh Vauhilhna

paite: kho thupi leh kilawm taktakte, na hihdim uh hi het lou, thil hoih chiteng a dim innte, na leh uh hi het lou tuikhuk lehsate, na suan uh hi het lou grephuan leh olive singte omna a hon pilut a, na nek ua na tai chiang un, pilvang mahmah un.
Huchi lou in zaw Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia TOUPA na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, ama nna na sem ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
pathian dangte na zui ding uh ahi kei, na kim ua mite pathiante na be ding uh ahi kei.
Na lak ua TOUPA na Pathian uh zaw Pathian mullit hat ahi; TOUPA na Pathian uh na tung uah aheh dia, lei a pan hon hihmang kha ding hi.
Massah a na ze-et bang un TOUPA na Pathian uh na ze-et ding uh ahi kei.
TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak, athupiakte, athu theihsakte leh adante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh.
TOUPA mitmuh a dik leh hoih na hih ding uh ahi. Huchi in nou a ding in ahoih dia, TOUPA'N na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, achiam gam hoih a lut in, na luah thei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N agensa bang in, na ma ua kipan na melma tengteng uh ahawlkhe ding hi.
Na tate un, "TOUPA i Pathian un thu hon piak, athu theihsaknate, dante, dan thusehte, bangchidan ahia?" chi a tunung lam chiang a ahon dot chiang un,
nou na tate uh kiang ah, "Aigupta gam ah Pharaoh sikha i na hi ua, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak in hon pikhia hi.
TOUPA'N i mitmuh un Aigupta gam tung ah, Pharaoh tung ah, a-inkuanpih tengteng tung ah, chiamtehna leh thillamdang, thupi leh huaise mahmahte amusak hi.
Eite bel hon pe dia i pi-le-pute kiang a piak ding chi a akichiam gam hon piaktheihna ding in huai gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
Huchi in hiai dan tengteng zui ding leh i hoih tawntungna dia TOUPA i Pathian laudan siam ding in TOUPA'N thu hon pia a, tuni a mihing a hon hawitheihna ding in.
Athu hon piak bang a TOUPA ma a thupiak tengteng zui dia i pilvanleh ei a ding in damna ahi ding," na chi ding uhi.
